content.text: Ticket t007 is an urgent billing complaint: the customer says they were charged $120 for the annual plan after cancelling in March, has a confirmation email, and threatens a chargeback if it isn't reversed today. The search returned four other billing tickets, and only t042 (a charge after cancellation) closely resembles it; the others concern a duplicate charge, an upgrade not applied, and a billing-switch question.
